scope_note: Control condition materially changes the estimated contrast; a waitlist estimate must not be reported as the effect versus active care.
statement: In the 2016 meta-analysis, CBT effect sizes were significantly larger against waiting lists than against care as usual or pill placebo for each included disorder.
statement_zh: 在 2016 年統合分析中，各納入疾病的 CBT 效果量在等待名單對照下，顯著高於常規照護或藥物安慰劑對照。
